items.html: And open your eyes and see what is the reason of this thing and its secret, and how this thing is necessary. And the matter is that it was explained above that the Yesod of AA is a soul within ZON, and clothes within them; therefore ZON must ascend upward into AVI, and then the Yesod of AA will also ascend upward with them into AVI; and it is male and female, as above, and couples from within itself; and then the Concealed Brain of AA is aroused, for 'from my flesh I shall behold God' — that the arousal of the lower Yesod causes an arousal in the brain of the man, to draw the drop of birth. Then the upper Concealed Brain of AA is aroused, and gives the power of the drop in the Mochin of AVI.
